description: This PHP class 'Each' is part of a validation rule set in the OrangeHRM system. It applies a given composite rule to each element of an iterable input to validate its items.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: A validation rule that applies a specified composite rule to each element of an iterable input to ensure all elements satisfy the rule.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a specific AbstractComposite rule.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that each element of the input iterable satisfies the given rule; throws an error if input is not iterable.
